messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Art. 27(1)

Article 27 Notifying authorities. 1. Member States shall designate a notifying authority that shall be responsible for setting up and carrying out the necessary procedures for the assessment and notification of conformity assessment bodies and the monitoring of notified bodies, including compliance with Article 32.

response.text:
Member States | shall designate | a notifying authority | | Member States shall designate a notifying authority
notifying authority | isResponsibleFor | setting up and carrying out the necessary procedures for the assessment and notification of conformity assessment bodies | | shall be responsible for setting up and carrying out the necessary procedures for the assessment and notification of conformity assessment bodies
notifying authority | isResponsibleFor | monitoring of notified bodies | | the monitoring of notified bodies
notifying authority | monitorsComplianceWith | Article 32 | in monitoring notified bodies | including compliance with Article 32
